color.name: color-bg-glow
color.usage: Fresh light over the top of every screen (leaf green and a touch of sun). Layered over color-bg, never under text-heavy cards alone.

color.name: color-surface
color.usage: Solid surfaces: fields, bottom action bars.

color.name: color-glass
color.usage: Cards, list rows and the tab bar: frosted glass over the glow (with a blur behind it).

color.name: color-glass-line
color.usage: The light edge of glass surfaces. Never for text.

color.name: color-line
color.usage: Borders and dividers. Never for text.

color.name: color-skeleton
color.usage: Placeholder bars on screens that are not designed yet. Never for text.

color.name: color-primary
color.usage: Brand and the main action; text and icons on light backgrounds.

color.name: color-primary-ink
color.usage: Text and icons on color-primary and its gradient.

color.name: color-primary-soft
color.usage: Secondary buttons, selected states, plant placeholders.

color.name: color-primary-gradient
color.usage: Fill of the main action and the selected tab: the brand at its most alive. White text only.

color.name: color-hero
color.usage: The big plant picture and success moments. Decoration only, no text on it.

type.name: text-heading
type.usage: Row titles, section headings, button labels.

type.name: text-caption
type.usage: Meta information under a title; tab labels.

space.name: space-half
space.usage: Between a title and its subtitle.

space.name: space-2
space.usage: Between items in a list or a button group.

space.name: space-5
space.usage: Between sections; home-indicator area under bars.

space.name: space-6
space.usage: Large gaps on empty and success states; page padding on web.

radius.name: radius-lg
radius.usage: The floating tab bar and the big plant picture.

shadow.name: shadow-card
shadow.usage: Glass cards and the tab bar.

shadow.name: shadow-raised
shadow.usage: The main action and the floating button: a soft green glow under them.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.usage: Default easing for anything that enters.
